scenarios.title: Former leader alive after losing quorum
scenarios.description: Leader partitioned from peers loses quorum, cannot renew lease, and write attempt fails.
scenarios.outcome: QuorumLossError on renew + FencingTokenError on expired write attempt

scenarios.title: Former leader isolated from new leader with destination access
scenarios.description: Old leader attempts direct write to shared persistence; intercepted by FencedWALWriter.

scenarios.title: Old leader reconnects after new leader commits
scenarios.description: Reconnected zombie leader attempts write after multiple newer epoch commits.

scenarios.title: Old leader restarts with stale local state
scenarios.description: Node boots with cold/stale epoch state and immediately attempts write before resync.

scenarios.title: Two leaders attempt concurrent commits
scenarios.description: Race between competing leaders resolved by strict monotonic highest epoch advance.

scenarios.title: Delayed message arrives after epoch transition
scenarios.description: Out-of-order in-flight payload stamped with preceding epoch arrives at storage.
scenarios.outcome: Epoch fence intercepted delayed frame in 0.90 us

scenarios.title: Write begins before fencing, reaches persistence after fencing
scenarios.description: In-flight transit delay causes token expiration prior to persistence barrier arrival.
scenarios.outcome: Lease expiration detected at fence gate in 1.20 us

scenarios.title: Durable backend restarts independently
scenarios.description: Persistence gate restores epoch state from checkpoint; rejects stale pre-restart tokens.
scenarios.outcome: Recovered fence state preserved; stale write rejected in 1.00 us

scenarios.title: Replication fails during leadership transition
scenarios.description: Candidate node unable to contact majority peers cannot acquire leadership.
scenarios.outcome: QuorumLossError raised; zero leadership tokens issued

scenarios.title: Minority partition attempts write acknowledgement
scenarios.description: Partitioned minority member attempts write ACK; blocked by lease abdication.
